articles.title: Sources: Jets get their QB, trade for Geno Smith
articles.summary: The Jets are trading for the Raiders' Geno Smith, reuniting the quarterback with the team that drafted him in 2013, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter on Tuesday.

articles.title: Source: Lions add RB Pacheco to pair with Gibbs
articles.summary: The Lions are signing Isiah Pacheco, giving the team a new running back to pair with Jahmyr Gibbs, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

articles.title: Sources: Pats land Packers' Doubs on 4-year deal
articles.summary: The Patriots have agreed to sign former Packers wide receiver Romeo Doubs to four-year deal worth up to $80 million, sources told ESPN.

articles.summary: Travis Kelce said that fiancée Taylor Swift was a significant influence on his decision to return to the Chiefs for his 14th NFL season.

articles.title: Sources: TE Knox stays with Bills on new deal
articles.summary: The Bills found a way to keep tight end Dawson Knox on the 2026 roster amid a difficult cap situation by signing him to a new three-year contract, sources told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler on Tuesday.

articles.title: Texans bolster O-line, reach deal with OT Smith
articles.summary: Free agent offensive tackle Braden Smith reached agreement with the Houston Texans on a two-year, $25 million contract that includes $13.5 million fully guaranteed, his agent told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

articles.title: Giants address CB need, agree to sign Newsome
articles.summary: The Giants addressed their need at cornerback, agreeing with Greg Newsome II on a one-year deal worth up to $10 million, his agents told ESPN.

articles.title: Source: WR Raymond leaves Lions to join Bears
articles.summary: Kalif Raymond has agreed to sign a one-year contract with the Bears, reuniting the wide receiver with Ben Johnson, a source told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler.

articles.title: Texans make Fairbairn NFL's highest-paid kicker
articles.summary: Houston's Ka'imi Fairbairn agreed to a two-year, $13 million extension, making him the highest-paid kicker in NFL history, his agency Athletes First announced Tuesday.

articles.summary: Star wide receiver Mike Evans is leaving the Buccaneers to sign a three-year deal with the 49ers, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

articles.title: Source: Steelers add RB Dowdle on 2-year deal
articles.summary: The Steelers are signing former Panthers standout running back Rico Dowdle to a two-year, $12.25 million deal, NFL Network reported Monday.

articles.title: Sources: Pats bulk up O-line, add Vera-Tucker
articles.summary: The Patriots bolstered their offensive line Monday night, agreeing to a three-year deal with the versatile but injury-plagued Alijah Vera-Tucker, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

articles.summary: Former Miami Dolphins quarterback Tua Tagovailoa plans to sign a one-year deal with the Atlanta Falcons, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

articles.title: Seahawks keep Shaheed in fold with $51M deal
articles.summary: The Seahawks are bringing back wide receiver Rashid Shaheed on a three-year, $51 million deal that includes $34.7 million guaranteed, agents Drew Rosenhaus and Robert Bailey told ESPN's Adam Schefter on Monday.

articles.title: Source: LB Lloyd gets $45M deal with Panthers
articles.summary: Former Jaguars linebacker Devin Lloyd agreed to a three-year, $45 million deal with the Panthers, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter on Monday.

articles.title: Source: Dobbins back to Broncos for 2 years, $20M
articles.summary: The Broncos are bringing back running back J.K. Dobbins on a two-year, $20 million deal that includes $8 million fully guaranteed at signing, NFL Network reported Monday.
